observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the left margin and the locator «p. 219.» (L15) in the right margin. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the heads of A and B: 5 stands beside the first line of the title of A, 35 a little below the first line of the title of B.
body L1-L3, L27-L30: the heads A and B are set in a larger bold type, the titles in a larger type, all centred; «(1)» after A and the letter a of the first title are in the type of the text.
body L3: a speck stands under the t of the last word of the title; it is not a sign.
body L24: a speck stands at mid height before «21»; it is not a sign.

transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
